parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time for the query. Specify the time in UTC, using the ISO-8601 format `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`.

parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: The keyword used for the query. The search covers the `MessageId`, `Title`, and `Body` fields. For `Title` and `Body`, the system applies Chinese word segmentation and matches whole tokens instead of substrings.

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: The page number to query. Default: 1. Maximum: 10,000.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default: 20. Maximum: 100.

parameters.name: PushType
parameters.description:
The push type. Valid values:

- **MESSAGE**: A message.

- **NOTICE**: A notification.

- **LIVE\_ACTIVITY**: A Live Activity.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The push source. Valid values:

- **API**: Pushes initiated via an OpenAPI call.

- **CONSOLE**: Pushes initiated from the Mobile Push console.

- **OpenAPIExplorer**: Pushes initiated from Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI Explorer.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time for the query. Specify the time in UTC, using the ISO-8601 format `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`.

parameters.name: Target
parameters.description:
The push target. Valid values:

- **DEVICE**: Push to devices.

- **ACCOUNT**: Push to accounts.

- **ALIAS**: Push to aliases.

- **TAG**: Push to tags.

- **ALL**: Push to all devices.

- **TBD**: Initializes a continuous push. The push target is specified in a subsequent call to the `ContinuouslyPush` API operation.
